V01.label: pg_trigger：public 且 NOT tgisinternal（我用的口径）
V01.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS n FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND NOT t.tgisinternal

V02.label: pg_trigger：public 全部（含 internal）
V02.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS n FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public'

V03.label: pg_trigger：public 且 tgisinternal IS NOT TRUE（NULL 也算）
V03.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS n FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND t.tgisinternal IS NOT TRUE

V04.label: pg_trigger：全库 NOT tgisinternal（不限 schema）
V04.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS n FROM pg_trigger t WHERE NOT t.tgisinternal

V05.label: pg_trigger：全库 全部
V05.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS n FROM pg_trigger

V06.label: pg_trigger：public 且 tgname NOT LIKE 'RI_%'
V06.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS n FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND t.tgname NOT LIKE 'RI\_%'

V07.label: pg_trigger：public 且 tgisinternal=false 且 tgconstraint=0（非约束触发器）
V07.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS n FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND NOT t.tgisinternal AND t.tgconstraint = 0

V08.label: pg_trigger：public 且 tgisinternal=false，按 DISTINCT tgname
V08.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT t.tgname)::text AS n FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND NOT t.tgisinternal

V09.label: pg_trigger：public 且 tgisinternal=false，按 DISTINCT tgrelid（有触发器的表数）
V09.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT t.tgrelid)::text AS n FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND NOT t.tgisinternal

V10.label: pg_trigger：按**函数**所在 schema=public 且 NOT tgisinternal
V10.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS n FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_proc p ON p.oid = t.tgfoid JOIN pg_namespace pn ON pn.oid = p.pronamespace WHERE pn.nspname='public' AND NOT t.tgisinternal

V11.label: pg_trigger：按**函数**所在 schema<>public 且 NOT tgisinternal
V11.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS n FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_proc p ON p.oid = t.tgfoid JOIN pg_namespace pn ON pn.oid = p.pronamespace WHERE pn.nspname <> 'public' AND NOT t.tgisinternal

V12.label: pg_trigger：public 且 NOT tgisinternal 且 tgparentid=0
V12.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS n FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND NOT t.tgisinternal AND t.tgparentid = 0

V13.label: pg_trigger：public 且 NOT tgisinternal 且 tgparentid<>0（分区克隆）
V13.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS n FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND NOT t.tgisinternal AND t.tgparentid <> 0

V14.label: pg_trigger：public 且 NOT tgisinternal 且 relkind='r'
V14.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS n FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND NOT t.tgisinternal AND c.relkind='r'

V15.label: pg_trigger：public 且 NOT tgisinternal 且 relkind<> 'r'（视图/外部表）
V15.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS n FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND NOT t.tgisinternal AND c.relkind<>'r'

V16.label: pg_trigger：public 且 NOT tgisinternal 且 tgenabled='O'
V16.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS n FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND NOT t.tgisinternal AND t.tgenabled='O'

V17.label: pg_trigger：public 且 NOT tgisinternal 且 tgenabled<>'D'
V17.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS n FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND NOT t.tgisinternal AND t.tgenabled<>'D'

V18.label: information_schema.triggers：trigger_schema=public 行数
V18.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS n FROM information_schema.triggers WHERE trigger_schema='public'

V19.label: information_schema.triggers：public 去重 (table,name)
V19.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT (event_object_table, trigger_name))::text AS n FROM information_schema.triggers WHERE trigger_schema='public'

V20.label: information_schema.triggers：action_timing/event_manipulation 组合数（替代无效列 action_schema）
V20.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS n FROM information_schema.triggers WHERE trigger_schema='public' AND action_timing='AFTER'

V21.label: information_schema.triggers：全库行数
V21.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS n FROM information_schema.triggers

V22.label: information_schema.triggers：public 行数（仅 ROW 级 / action_orientation=ROW）
V22.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS n FROM information_schema.triggers WHERE trigger_schema='public' AND action_orientation='ROW'

V23.label: pg_constraint：public 表上全部约束数
V23.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS n FROM pg_constraint k JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=k.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public'

V24.label: pg_constraint：public 表上 FOREIGN KEY 约束数
V24.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS n FROM pg_constraint k JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=k.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND k.contype='f'

V25.label: pg_event_trigger：全库
V25.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS n FROM pg_event_trigger

V26.label: pg_trigger：public NOT tgisinternal 且 tgtype 含 ROW(1) 位
V26.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS n FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND NOT t.tgisinternal AND (t.tgtype::int & 1) = 1

V27.label: pg_trigger：public NOT tgisinternal 且 tgtype 含 BEFORE(2) 位
V27.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS n FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND NOT t.tgisinternal AND (t.tgtype::int & 2) = 2

V28.label: pg_trigger：public NOT tgisinternal 且 tgtype 含 AFTER(64) 位
V28.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS n FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND NOT t.tgisinternal AND (t.tgtype::int & 64) = 64

V29.label: pg_trigger：public NOT tgisinternal 且 tgtype 含 INSTEAD(32) 位
V29.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS n FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND NOT t.tgisinternal AND (t.tgtype::int & 32) = 32

V30.label: pg_trigger：public NOT tgisinternal，tgname 以 trg_ 开头
V30.sql: SELECT count(*)::text AS n FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND NOT t.tgisinternal AND t.tgname LIKE 'trg\_%'

V31.label: pg_trigger：public NOT tgisinternal，且 tgfoid 属于 0013–0017 之后建的对象（tgfoid > 0 恒真，占位口径）
V31.sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT t.tgfoid)::text AS n FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND NOT t.tgisinternal

V32.label: pg_trigger：public NOT tgisinternal，按 tgfoid 去重后的**函数数**与触发器数差
V32.sql: SELECT (count(*) - count(DISTINCT t.tgfoid))::text AS n FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND NOT t.tgisinternal

B_event_manipulation.sql: SELECT event_manipulation AS k, count(*)::text AS n FROM information_schema.triggers WHERE trigger_schema='public' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

B_timing.sql: SELECT action_timing AS k, count(*)::text AS n FROM information_schema.triggers WHERE trigger_schema='public' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

B_event_orientation.sql: SELECT event_manipulation || '/' || action_orientation AS k, count(*)::text AS n FROM information_schema.triggers WHERE trigger_schema='public' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

B_per_table.sql: SELECT c.relname AS k, count(*)::text AS n FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND NOT t.tgisinternal GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

B_schemas.sql: SELECT n.nspname AS k, count(*)::text AS n FROM pg_namespace n GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
